prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.)
text: Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of northbound traffic on a city street in League City, Texas, waiting for a red signal at the intersection. Driver 2 was traveling directly behind Driver 1 and did not stop in time, striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Both vehicles sustained visible rear-end damage, and both drivers were able to exit their vehicles under their own power. Driver 2 stated that the roadway was damp and that they had looked down at a phone for a moment before braking. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was checked at the scene and reported no injuries. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and stiffness in the neck and was transported by EMS to a local hospital for evaluation. No citations were issued at the scene pending review of the statements and the vehicle damage. Traffic lanes were partially blocked for approximately twenty minutes until both vehicles were moved to the shoulder.
